provenance.value: Adding a sub-unit offset parameter (e.g. offset=pd.Timedelta(1)) to a non-nano DatetimeIndex with non-vectorized offsets (CustomBusinessDay, CustomBusinessMonthBegin, CustomBusinessMonthEnd) incorrectly rounds/truncates the result because _add_offset forces the result back to self.dtype via as_unit(self.unit); apply_wraps could also leave a raw datetime.datetime when the as_unit conversion was lossy, causing AttributeError on subsequent tz_localize calls.

The result should keep the finer resolution between self.unit and offset.offset's unit, so sub-unit precision introduced by the offset is not truncated; the result should be a proper Timestamp rather than raising AttributeError.
